amendment.scope: Four bed games on unchanged ee2b7f18; ATP_MAIN and ATP_CHALL calibration strictly from earlier library games. No bed/tune outcomes or tutoring. Same ALT/GAS calibration/entry definitions.
amendment.pool: Installed first-price weights, direction-matched member outcomes, FIRST then BASE; unchanged side/role, category, walk-forward and same-day exclusions
amendment.target: At least one strictly later cutter-accepted positive-size print at or below translated L and strictly before member bell. No-hit member keeps its weight. No carried price or zero-size print counts.
amendment.witness_limitation: Held cutter witness source has unknown block status, inherited and disclosed; this experiment does not claim verified non-block reach or known queue priority.
amendment.calibration: Filed weighted isotonic PAV, category/side/receipt-time role/selected layer/atlas gate separately. One total weight per earlier called library game over all legal integer-cent levels below its current. Train only on games whose bell precedes the query formation, excluding self and event-name same day. No named/tune outcomes. No earlier rows means no permission.
amendment.application: Piecewise-linear interpolation and explicit endpoint clipping as filed. At a receipt use the latest atlas gate already reached within the query span, never a future gate. Raw probabilities are recomputed at the actual receipt. No curve before the first available gate.
amendment.validation: Walk-forward held-out library predictions, raw and calibrated probabilities versus realized reach by absolute L, depth below current and gate; raw-only versus common calibration coverage separate. Report Brier and endpoint clipping. No tuning from these results.
amendment.decision: Legal market increments from band q25 inclusive to below current, maker-only and actual pair cap. Maximize calibrated P(reach before bell) times (riser close destination + faller floor destination - actual filled or licensed riser cost - L). Positive discount and positive expected discount required. Exact objective ties retain the standing feasible level, then lower cent, inheriting filed reach-map order.
amendment.unchanged: Destinations, role call, learned faller window, fresh deadline requirement, riser entry, post-only, veto, actual commitment cap, same-second rejection, fill law and replay clock. Default flag off. No automatic installation.
amendment.acceptance: Synthetic strict-witness, isotonic and argmax tests; source/temporal checks; actual OS replay twice; flag-off digest identical; face source equality and hosted verification. No result numbers prescribed.

witness.witness_limitation: Cutter-accepted positive-size prints; inherited source has unknown block status, as disclosed in the filed reach-map run. No carried price, zero-size, same-time or at/after-bell witness.

scope: Bed-game actual OS replay through unchanged ee2b7f18, calibrated expected pair discount flagged on. No default installation.
